question:
Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

It automatically (adjusts) resistance to match the road grade.
solution:
The correct answer is "**disorganize.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• "**Adjusts"** means to change or alter something to fit a particular requirement.(समायोजन करना)
 
 
• Example: You need to adjust the tables accordingly.
 
 
 
• "**Disorganize**" means to cause confusion or chaos.(अव्यवस्था करना)
 
 
• Example: I'm afraid my household is terribly disorganized.
 
 
 
• The two words are opposite in meaning as one implies order and the other implies disorder.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1, **rectify** means to correct or fix something.(सुधारना)
 
• In option 2, **order** means to give instructions or commands. (आदेश)
 
• In option 3, **suit** means to be appropriate or suitable for something.(सुविधाजनक होना)
